COMET RADIANCE: Shortly after the start shifted in and bumped SPICY SPANGLE.  Sent for sampling post-race.
JOY STAR: Over the concluding stages raced tight to the inside of ICONICAL which shifted in slightly.
SPICY SPANGLE: Bumped shortly after the start.  Apprentice P N Wong reported that her instructions were to go forward but she was obliged to make some use of the horse in the early stages to comply with those instructions.  She added as a result SPICY SPANGLE did not finish the race off in the Home Straight.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
ZETA HEDGE: Z Purton stated that from the outside barrier he was instructed to go forward.  He said when unable to cross runners to his inside ZETA HEDGE raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event before giving ground in the Home Straight.  Trainer C W Chang confirmed the instructions issued.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
ALWAYS MY FOLKS: Leaving the 300  Metres improved into a narrow run between COMET RADIANCE and ZETA HEDGE which was commencing to give ground.  As a result ALWAYS MY FOLKS had difficulty obtaining clear running between the 300 Metres and the 200 Metres.  Sent for sampling post-race.
CELESTIAL STRIDER: Slow to begin.  Over the final 50 Metres was held up behind MAPOGO.  Noted to have blood in the mouth after the race.
SOLAR RIVER: Jumped awkwardly and lost ground.  Between the 300 Metres and the 200 Metres had difficulty obtaining clear running when being shifted to the outside of COMET RADIANCE.  Noted to have blood in the mouth after the race.
RUNJEET: A Badel advised that the instructions were to go forward.  He said RUNJEET was slow to begin and as a result settled back in the field.  He added RUNJEET failed to travel throughout the race and did not run on when placed under pressure in the Home Straight.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
LOVELY MILES: After being crossed by WINNING DIAMOND approaching the 1300 Metres commenced to race keenly and was steadied to avoid WINNING DIAMOND.  When questioned Apprentice H Y Yuen stated that her instructions were to hold a handy position with cover.  She said in the early stages LOVELY MILES showed sufficient pace to hold a position behind the leader WINNING DIAMOND.  She said approaching the 1100 Metres when her mount was racing keenly she was reluctant to make use of it to prevent SUPER SICARIO from shifting in as she was concerned this would result in her mount racing too keenly.  She said as a result SUPER SICARIO was able to obtain a position in advance of LOVELY MILES and behind WINNING DIAMOND near the 1100 Metres. When questioned as the reason why her mount was obliged to race wide and without cover from the 1000 Metres, Apprentice Yuen stated that when making the turn near the 1000 Metres her mount shifted out which provided an opportunity for GOR GOR to obtain a position one-off behind SUPER SICARIO and this resulted in her mount being obliged to race wide and without cover thereafter. She further stated that after making contact with GOR GOR near the 550 Metres her mount shifted out which resulted in TELECOM POWER then improving to her inside and LOVELY MILES being obliged to race very wide making the Home Turn.  Trainer P F Yiu confirmed the instructions were consistent with previous instructions he issued at the horse’s most recent starts.  The Stewards advised Apprentice Yuen that she had made two errors of judgement in the early stages firstly near the 1100 Metres by not making a greater effort to hold her position behind WINNING DIAMOND to prevent SUPER SICARIO from shifting in and secondly near the 1000 Metres by permitting her mount to shift out to a three wide position which afforded GOR GOR the opportunity to obtain a position one-off following SUPER SICARIO.  She was further advised that whilst acknowledging her inexperience as an apprentice jockey in future she would be expected to show better judgement than what she did during the early stages of this race.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race found that horse to have sustained a laceration to the right hind cannon.
MONTA FRUTTA: Jumped awkwardly, made contact with the left side of its starting gate and lost ground.  Y L Chung reported that his mount did not travel throughout the event and came under pressure from the 800 Metres where it gave ground from that point.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race revealed that the horse was displaying an irregular heart rhythm.  As this was the 3rd occasion within 24 months that the horse had been found to have an irregular heart rhythm, it is now to be compulsorily retired from racing in Hong Kong.
WHOWROTETHATSONG: Jumped awkwardly.  From a wide barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.  Sent for sampling post-race.
CAN'T GO WONG: Shifted in on jumping and made contact with TO INFINITY.
SUPER SICARIO: Brushed near the 300 Metres.  Near the 200 Metres was bumped by OUR LUCKY GLORY which lay out.
TO INFINITY: Prior to the running of the event Trainer J Richards advised that the horse would be ridden in a conservative manner tonight.  He said he issued those instructions as TO INFINITY had raced disappointingly at its most recent start when ridden in a forward position.  Bumped at the start.
OUR LUCKY GLORY: Near the 300 Metres improved into a narrow run between PRINCE ALEX and SUPER SICARIO and made slight contact with SUPER SICARIO.  Again near the 200 Metres SUPER SICARIO and OUR LUCKY GLORY made contact when OUR LUCKY GLORY lay out.
LUCKY BLESSING: K C Leung stated that his mount was able to obtain a comfortable lead, but failed to respond to his riding upon entering the Home Straight and gave ground noticeably.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  The performance of LUCKY BLESSING was considered disappointing.  Before being allowed to race again, LUCKY BLESSING will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
TELECOM POWER: H Bentley stated that after obtaining a handy position behind LOVELY MILES in the early stages his mount was shuffled back in the field when LOVELY MILES did not hold its position behind the leaders.  He said after then having to make a run from the 600 Metres and being briefly held up on the Home Turn TELECOM POWER did not finish its race off in the Home Straight.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race which included an endoscopic examination showed a substantial amount of blood in the horse’s trachea.  The performance of TELECOM POWER was considered disappointing.  Before being allowed to race again, TELECOM POWER will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.  Sent for sampling post-race.
PRINCE ALEX: L Hewitson was fined the sum of $2,000 for initially presenting himself to be weighed out with the incorrect saddle cloth number.  L Hewitson stated that whilst his instructions were to take advantage of his inside barrier PRINCE ALEX jumped well and was able to hold a position behind the lead.  He added PRINCE ALEX raced slightly further forward than he had anticipated.
WINNING DIAMOND: Prior to the running of the event Trainer D Eustace confirmed that from the outside barrier he instructed R Kingscote to take up a forward position if circumstances permitted.  Made contact with a rail exiting the Parade Ring, was examined by the Veterinary Officer at the Start and passed suitable to race.  Sent for sampling post-race.
BROWNNEEDSFURTHER: Near the 950 Metres improved to the inside of MASTER CHAMPION and as a result was steadied to avoid MASTER CHAMPION.  Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.  Sent for sampling post-race.
THUNDER ACTION: Shifted out at the start and made contact with TOURBILLON GOLFER.  Lay out in the Home Straight and near the 100 Metres shifted out and brushed TOURBILLON GOLFER.  Sent for sampling post-race.
MASTER CHAMPION: Apprentice H Y Yuen stated that after having to make use of her mount in the early stages to go forward MASTER COMPANION gave ground when under pressure in the Home Straight.  She added, in her opinion, MASTER CHAMPION would be better suited by dropping back in distance for its next race start.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
TOURBILLON GOLFER: Bumped at the start.  Sent for sampling post-race.
RELENTLESS PURSUIT: Jumped only fairly.  From the outside barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
JOKER ORBIT: After travelling a short distance was steadied when crowded between MASTER CHAMPION and MEGA AWESOME which shifted out despite the efforts of its rider.  K C Leung reported that as a consequence his mount settled further back in the field than what had been intended.  Near the 350 Metres was held up for clear running behind LIGHTNESS OF BEING.  A short distance later JOKER ORBIT was steadied to avoid MEGA AWESOME (L Hewitson) which shifted out.  L Hewitson was advised to exercise more care.  JOKER ORBIT was then shifted to the inside of MEGA AWESOME to continue into clear running.
LIGHTNESS OF BEING: Approaching the 100 Metres was eased to avoid TOURBILLON GOLFER which shifted out after making slight contact with THUNDER ACTION.  Y L Chung could offer no explanation for the horse failing to run on in the Home Straight.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
PODIUM: From a wide barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
WELL ENOUGH: On jumping was crowded between SILVERY KNIGHT and LUCKY TOGETHER, both of which shifted ground.  Throughout the early stages raced keenly, got its head up and refused to settle.  When being crossed by AMAZING AWARD near the 1400 Metres WELL ENOUGH was steadied to avoid AMAZING AWARD. Lay in over the final 200 Metres.
SEA CHARIOT: From a wide barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.  Near the 550 Metres was steadied to avoid BEST WORLD when racing keenly.  Held up for clear running on the Home Turn.  Approaching the 100  Metres, when commencing to finish the race off, was steadied and shifted to the outside of COOGEE BAY when COOGEE BAY was giving ground.
BEST WORLD: Jumped only fairly.  Near the 50 Metres was shifted to the outside of VIVA FIRECRACKER to continue into clear running.  Approaching the finish could not be fully ridden out when unable to continue to improve between VIVA FIRECRACKER and AMAZING AWARD.
SILVERY KNIGHT: On jumping shifted in, made contact with WELL ENOUGH and became unbalanced.  Approaching the 450 Metres was hampered when taken wider by LUCKY TOGETHER which shifted out to improve.  Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
GAZELEY: Near the 550 Metres was checked to avoid LUCKY TOGETHER when racing keenly.  Near the 150 Metres made contact with LUCKY TOGETHER due to both runners shifting ground.  M Chadwick stated that from the outside barrier he had expected to take up a handy position.  He said when GAZELEY jumped awkwardly and lost ground he elected to ride the horse in a conservative manner.  Trainer K W Lui confirmed the instructions.
LUCKY TOGETHER: Shifted out at the start and made contact with WELL ENOUGH.  A short distance later was then steadied when crowded between WELL ENOUGH and PRESIDENT PEGASUS, both of which shifted ground.  Approaching the 1400 Metres was steadied when crowded between SILVERY KNIGHT and PRESTIGE RICKY which shifted out when being steadied to avoid PRESIDENT PEGASUS.  LUCKY TOGETHER then raced keenly in the early stages.  Near the 550 Metres was steadied to avoid WELL ENOUGH when racing keenly.  Shifted out to improve near the 450 Metres and was bumped.  Near the 150 Metres made contact with GAZELEY due to both runners shifting ground.
QUICK CONTRIBUTION: M F Poon stated that the intention was to hold a midfield position.  He said when QUICK CONTRIBUTION jumped only fairly this resulted in the horse settling further back than intended.  He added that after following SILVERY KNIGHT during the race, when that runner did not take him into the event, he was disadvantaged by racing back in the field, particularly with the early and middle stages being run outside of standard time.  He added as a consequence QUICK CONTRIBUTION found it difficult to make up ground in the Home Straight.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  Whilst the Stewards acknowledged the circumstances of the race were not run to suit QUICK CONTRIBUTION, the performance was considered disappointing as compared to its previous race start.  Before being allowed to race again, QUICK CONTRIBUTION will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.  Sent for sampling post-race.
PRESIDENT PEGASUS: Shifted in at the start and made contact with PRESTIGE RICKY.  L Hewitson stated that he was instructed to make us of the inside barrier and after commencing well he was able to hold an on-pace position but slightly more forward than what he had anticipated.
PRESTIGE RICKY: Bumped at the start.  Approaching the finish was steadied to avoid AMAZING AWARD when taken out by BEST WORLD.
GALLANT DESIGN: Near the 400 Metres CORNERSTONE was eased when racing tight to the inside of PACKING SMART.  As a result GALLANT DESIGN was then checked to avoid CORNERSTONE when it gave ground.
LUNAR DASH: Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.
SOLID CAR: On jumping made contact with FLYING TING LOK due to both runners shifting ground.
TACTICAL ACE: Shortly after the start was bumped on the hindquarters.  Lay in under pressure in the Home Straight.  M F Poon reported that he was instructed to hold an on-pace position but not necessarily lead.  He said after commencing well TACTICAL ACE was able to hold the lead when it showed superior pace.
UNSTOPPAPLE: Shifted out on jumping despite the efforts of its rider and made contact with PACKING SMART.  Leaving the 250 Metres was shifted to the outside of TACTICAL ACE to continue into clear running.  After the race an endoscopic examination was conducted on UNSTOPPAPLE at the request of Trainer C S Shum.  The Veterinary Surgeon said this examination showed a substantial amount of blood in the horse’s trachea.  Before being allowed to race again, UNSTOPPAPLE will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
COPARTNER FLEET: Lay in in the early stages of the Home Straight.  Near the 100 Metres was steadied when disappointed for clear running between SOLID CAR and FLYING TING LOK.  COPARTNER FLEET was then shifted to the inside of FLYING TING LOK to obtain clear running.  After improving to the inside of FLYING TING LOK passing the 50 Metres was then checked approaching the winning post when crowded by FLYING TING LOK which, after laying out when being corrected by its rider A Atzeni, then shifted in.  A Atzeni was severely reprimanded.
PACKING SMART: Bounded on jumping and then shortly afterwards was steadied when crowded between TACTICAL ACE and UNSTOPPAPLE which shifted out despite the efforts of its rider.  Near the 550 Metres was steadied when crowded by LUNAR DASH (K Teetan) which shifted in when not sufficiently clear before being corrected.  K Teetan was severely reprimanded and advised he must ensure he leaves sufficient racing room for runners to his inside.  Near the 300 Metres had some difficulty obtaining clear running when improving between LUNAR DASH and FLYING TING LOK.  Sent for sampling post-race.
SYNERGY IN ACTION: Passing the 100 Metres was eased to avoid GALLANT DESIGN which shifted out.  Trainer P C Ng confirmed that from a wide barrier the instructions were to ride the horse in a conservative manner in the early stages.  He added these instructions were consistent with those issued at its most recent start on 31 October 2026.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race found that horse to have blood in the mouth.
CORNERSTONE: Jumped only fairly.  Near the 400 Metres was eased when racing tight to the inside of PACKING SMART.
FLYING TING LOK: On jumping made contact with SOLID CAR due to both runners shifting ground.  Near the 550 Metres was hampered when taken out by PACKING SMART.  Sent for sampling post-race.
STORMING DRAGON: Z Purton stated that he did not receive any specific instructions other than to ensure his mount commenced well and endeavour to hold an on-pace position.  He said when STORMING DRAGON jumped well it showed sufficient pace to lead the event.  Trainer J Richards confirmed the instructions and advised the instructions were consistent with those issued at the horse’s most recent start on 7 October 2026.  Sent for sampling post-race.
DOUBLE MONEY: Jumped only fairly.  Was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.  Between the 500 Metres and the 400 Metres raced tight to the inside of SASSPHIRE.
CHARMING BABE: In the Home Straight lay in and proved difficult to ride out.
FRIENDS OF SHAJING: Near the 700 Metres was eased to avoid CROSSBORDERDUDE (A Atzeni) which shifted in when not sufficiently clear.  A Atzeni was advised to exercise more care.  C L Chau reported that his mount did not travel well during the event.  He added in the Home Straight FRIENDS OF SHAJING did not respond to his riding and over the final 100 Metres he had some concern with its action.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  Before being allowed to race again, FRIENDS OF SHAJING will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
OUTGATE: Y L Chung could offer no explanation for his mount’s failure to run on in the Home Straight.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
HEALTHY HEALTHY: Prior to the running of the event Trainer P C Ng confirmed that from the outside barrier the instructions were to go forward.  Despite being ridden along in the early stages failed to show sufficient pace to hold a more forward position and raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.
SASSPHIRE: From a wide barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.  L Hewitson reported that his mount lay in during the running of the event.
SIGHT GENIUS: Slow to begin.  M F Poon reported that near the 400 Metres his mount shifted in towards the running rail and became unbalanced.
KWAI CHUNG TALENTS: KWAI CHUNG TALENTS, which was fractious in the starting gates, jumped only fairly.
LOCH TAY: Lay in in the Home Straight.
SOLID WIN: Near the 50 Metres was steadied when crowded by LOCH TAY (R Kingscote) which shifted in.  R Kingscote was reprimanded.
FLOW WATER FLOW: From a wide barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
STAY COSMIC: M F Poon stated that from an inside barrier when his mount commenced well it obtained a more forward position than anticipated, particularly when runners drawn beside him did not show early pace.
RISING PHOENIX: Apprentice P N Wong stated that after settling back in the field her mount was disadvantaged when the pace steadied in the middle stages and as a result found it difficult to make up ground in the Home Straight.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
DO YOUR PART: Trainer K W Lui advised that the intention was to go forward.  He said when DO YOUR PART jumped only fairly it settled slightly further back than had been intended.  Sent for sampling post-race. C L Chau warned in relation to using his whip in a manner where the hand holding the whip was above shoulder height on three occasions inside the 100 Metres.
CALL ME TOPSEED: Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.
MONEY GAMES: Shortly after the start blundered and became unbalanced.  Raced keenly in the early stages.  Near the 550 Metres was steadied when momentarily crowded between CALL ME TOPSEED and DO YOUR PART which shifted out.  Sent for sampling post-race.
NATURAL NUMBERS: From a wide barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.  M Chadwick stated that after settling back in the field as expected, when the pace eased near the 800 Metres he allowed his mount to stride forward to follow CORLEONE.  He said from the 550 Metres he was then obliged to race very wide and without cover when commencing a forward move as he felt it was necessary to do so given the middle stages of the event were run outside of standard time.  He added in the Home Straight his mount found it difficult to finish the race off from back in the field.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
STORMI: K Teetan reported that he had to make some use of the horse in the early stages to obtain the lead.  He said STORMI was then disadvantaged when SOLID WIN improved to its outside and as a consequence was left without a finishing effort in the Home Straight.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
GOD OF PI: Prior to the running of the event Trainer K L Man advised the intention was to hold a forward position.  Despite being ridden along in the early stages and after being crowded shortly after the start did not show sufficient pace to hold a more forward position.  Shortly after the start became unbalanced when crowded between JUBILANT WINNER and KING OF FIGHTERS which shifted out and away from SPICY STANDARD. Near the 850 Metres, when racing keenly, shifted in towards SPICY STANDARD and a result was steadied to avoid SPICY STANDARD.  When being corrected GOD OF PI became unbalanced when it shifted out.  GOD OF PI then raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.  K Teetan stated that whilst the horse had trialed satisfactorily at Happy Valley on 9 October 2026 it raced greenly throughout the event and did not appear to appreciate the Happy Valley circuit.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
TARGET AUDIENCE: Shifted in shortly after the start and made contact with NOTTHESILLYONE.  From a wide barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.  Sent for sampling post-race.
YOUNG EMPEROR: From the outside barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
FLASHING FIGHTER: Over the concluding stages was steadied to avoid TARGET AUDIENCE (A Badel) which shifted in when not sufficiently clear.  A Badel was reprimanded.
SPICY STANDARD: Near the 850 Metres was steadied to avoid FLASHING FIGHTER when racing keenly.
LIVE WIRE: Z Purton stated that his mount showed sufficient pace to lead the event as expected.  He said when asked for an effort in the Home Straight LIVE WIRE did not respond to his riding and near the 150 Metres when he was concerned there was something amiss he did not fully test the horse to the finish of the event.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race revealed that the horse was displaying an irregular heart rhythm.  Before being allowed to race again, LIVE WIRE will be required to perform satisfactorily in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.  Sent for sampling post-race.
KING OF FIGHTERS: Shortly after the start shifted out and away from SPICY STANDARD and was bumped.  Near the 850 Metres was momentarily crowded by GOD OF PI which shifted in before being corrected.  Near the 550 Metres was eased to avoid TARGET AUDIENCE which shifted out.
ACE CHAMPION: Near the 550 Metres was steadied when momentarily crowded by KING MILES which shifted in before being corrected.  ACE CHAMPION then raced keenly between the 500 Metres and the 400 Metres when positioned close to SYMBOL OF STRENGTH.  Over the final 100 Metres lay in.  Sent for sampling post-race.
SYMBOL OF STRENGTH: Shortly after the start shifted in and made contact with QUANTUM CLOUD. Between the 200 Metres and the 100 Metres had difficulty obtaining clear running.
FORTUNE LINK: Apprentice H Y Yuen stated that she was given the option to go forward if her mount commenced well.  She said when FORTUNE LINK jumped only fairly she elected to ride the horse in a conservative manner to avoid covering additional ground.
ALL OUT FOR SIX: Between the 250 Metres and the 150 Metres was bumped by QUANTUM CLOUD which was being shifted to the outside of CALIFORNIA BLITZ.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race found that horse to have bled from both nostrils.  Before being allowed to race again, will be required to perform satisfactorily in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
POWER KOEPP: Prior to the running of the event Trainer M Newnham confirmed that from a wide barrier he instructed L Ferraris to take up a forward position as he was of the opinion that there was not significant pace engaged in the race.  Steadied near the 100 Metres.  Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.
IT IS YOU: C L Chau was fined the sum of $5,000 for being unable to make the weight.  Permission was given for R Kingscote to be substituted as the rider of IT IS YOU.  Jumped only fairly.
QUANTUM CLOUD: Shortly after the start became unbalanced when bumped by SYMBOL OF STRENGTH.  Between the 250 Metres and the 150 Metres made contact with ALL OUT FOR SIX when being shifted to the outside of CALIFORNIA BLITZ to obtain clear running.  After obtaining a position to the outside of CALIFORNIA BLITZ, QUANTUM CLOUD (L Hewitson) then shifted out, resulting in ALL OUT FOR SIX being taken out across POWER KOEPP, causing POWER KOEPP to be steadied near the 100 Metres.  L Hewitson was advised to exercise more care.
VIVA PROSPERAR: On jumping made contact with YOUNG ARROW due to both runners shifting ground.
YOUNG ARROW: On jumping made contact with VIVA PROSPERAR due to both runners shifting ground. Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.
